title_zh: 核对定义并商定图示修改

scenario.goal_zh: 确认元素定义清楚，并商定补充化合物解释及图示标签来区分两者。

context_zh: 同学互看准备在化学课上展示的术语说明页。
author: author-phase05-b

sentences.speaker: Ewan
sentences.text: Could you read my definition of an element? I am not sure it is clear.

sentences.speaker: Lina
sentences.text: You wrote that it is a substance containing one type of atom. That part is clear.

sentences.speaker: Ewan
sentences.text: Should I define a compound on the same page?

sentences.speaker: Lina
sentences.text: Yes, otherwise the two pictures may confuse people. Your diagram needs labels.

sentences.speaker: Ewan
sentences.text: I will label this group as oxygen and the other as water.

sentences.speaker: Lina
sentences.text: Good. Show that the water contains two types of atom joined together, while the oxygen contains only one type.

sentences.speaker: Ewan
sentences.text: I will add that explanation below the pictures, then ask our teacher to check the page.

sentences.speaker: Lina
sentences.text: That will make the difference much easier to see.
